label: Google Jobs
description: Arcade.dev LLM tools for getting job postings via Google Jobs

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query. Provide a job title, company name, and/or any keywords in general representing what kind of jobs the user is looking for. E.g. 'software engineer' or 'data analyst at Apple'.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Location to search for jobs. E.g. 'United States' or 'New York, NY'. Defaults to any location.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: 2-character language code to use in the Google Jobs search. E.g. 'en' for English. Defaults to 'en'.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to retrieve. Defaults to 10 (max supported by the API).

parameters.name: next_page_token
parameters.description: Next page token to paginate results. Defaults to the first page.

documentationChunks.content:
The Arcade Google Jobs MCP Server uses the [SerpAPI](https://serpapi.com/) to get job data from Google Jobs.
- **Secret:**
  - `SERP_API_KEY`: Your SerpAPI API key.
    <Callout type="info">
      Setting the `SERP_API_KEY` secret is only required if you are
      [self-hosting](/guides/deployment-hosting/configure-engine) Arcade. If you're
      using Arcade Cloud, the secret is already set for you. To manage your
      secrets, go to the [Secrets
      page](https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets) in the Arcade
      Dashboard.
    </Callout>

## Default parameters

Language is configurable through environment variables. When set, they will be used as default for Google Jobs tools.

Providing a different value as `language` argument in a tool call will override the default value.

**Language**

The language code is a 2-character code that determines the language in which the API will search and return news articles. There are two environment variables:

- `ARCADE_GOOGLE_LANGUAGE`: a default value for all Google search tools. If not set, defaults to 'en' (English).
- `ARCADE_GOOGLE_JOBS_LANGUAGE`: a default value for the jobs search tools. If not set, defaults to `ARCADE_GOOGLE_LANGUAGE`.

A list of supported language codes can be found [here](#languagecodes).

- **`bn`**: Bengali

summary:
## Google Jobs Toolkit

The Google Jobs toolkit lets LLMs search live job postings by querying Google Jobs through the SerpAPI service.

## Capabilities

- **Job search**: Query Google Jobs for job postings using natural language or structured search terms via SerpAPI.

## Secrets

- `SERP_API_KEY`: Your SerpAPI API key, used to authenticate requests to the SerpAPI Google Jobs endpoint. Obtain it by creating an account at [SerpAPI](https://serpapi.com/), then navigate to your [dashboard](https://serpapi.com/dashboard) to copy your private API key. Free-tier accounts include a limited number of monthly searches; a paid plan is required for higher volume. The key must be stored as a secret in Arcade before the toolkit can make any requests.

See the [Arcade secrets documentation](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/guides/create-tools/tool-basics/create-tool-secrets) for how to configure secrets, or add them directly at https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets.
